title: Payment authorization latency
summary: Payment authorization p95 latency increased from 1.2s to 4.8s for 47 minutes after a processor-routing change amplified synchronous dependency calls.

title: Identity login degradation
summary: Login and token validation experienced intermittent failures for 31 minutes after a certificate renewal introduced an invalid trust-chain configuration.

title: Notification backlog
summary: Notification delivery backlog grew during a third-party provider slowdown because workers did not scale quickly enough.

title: Search indexing delay
summary: Search indexing lag exceeded four hours after a worker regression increased document processing time.

title: Customer profile data lag
summary: Profile synchronization from Data Platform was delayed for about 68 minutes after a stuck consumer group.

title: API Gateway certificate renewal failure
summary: A production certificate renewal failed for one API Gateway cluster, causing TLS handshake failures for a subset of CommerceCloud and BillingPro traffic.
